# Generated 2026-07-28

# AXIS
> Open charting PWA — own the axes, swap the engine

Installable AXIS for price and time. Orthogonal plugins: sources, streams, engines, storage. Full Pine surface via PYNE.

## Primary

- [Marketing](https://hoox.sh/axis): Product landing
- [Docs](https://hoox.sh/axis/docs): Full documentation hub
- [Repository](https://github.com/jango-blockchained/pynescript): Source monorepo
- [Docs tree](https://github.com/jango-blockchained/pynescript/tree/main/docs/axis): MDX source of truth
- [llm.txt](https://hoox.sh/axis/docs/llm.txt): Full-corpus minified context
- [llms.txt](https://hoox.sh/axis/docs/llms.txt): This file
- [PYNE docs](https://hoox.sh/pyne/docs): Language runtime (separate product)
- [HOOX docs](https://hoox.sh/docs): Edge trade mesh
